en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 30, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include Apple's visionOS 27 preview showcasing eye-control for wheelchairs, Standard Chartered Singapore winning the World's Best Digital Bank award for CX, National AgrAbility's inclusion in Forbes Accessibility 200, Windows Terminal Canary adding screen-reader improvements, and a look at accessible bathroom design requirements.

highlights.title: Designing Accessible Bathrooms Requires Adequate Space for Wheelchair Users
Standard Chartered Singapore Wins World’s Best Digital Bank for CX
National AgrAbility Named to Forbes Accessibility 200 List
Windows Terminal Canary adds screen reader accessibility improvements
Apple visionOS 27 Preview Shows New Accessibility Features: Vision Pro Eye Control for Electric Wheelchairs, Launching September

zh-TW.title: 每日無障礙消息摘要 – 2026年5月30日
zh-TW.summary: 今日重點包括蘋果 visionOS 27 預告展示 Vision Pro 眼控操作電動輪椅、星展銀行新加坡榮獲全球最佳數字銀行客戶體驗獎、國家農業能力項目入選福布斯無障礙200強、Windows Terminal Canary 加入螢幕閱讀器無障礙改進，以及無障礙浴室設計需提供足夠輪椅空間。

highlights.title: 无障碍浴室设计需保证轮椅使用者的空间
星展银行新加坡荣获全球最佳数字银行客户体验奖
国家农业能力项目入选福祉无障碍200强榜单
Windows Terminal Canary 增加屏幕阅读器无障碍改进
Apple visionOS 27 預告無障礙新功能：Vision Pro 眼控操作電動輪椅、9 月正式上線
